## Type of Change

- [ ] New skill file
- [ ] Improvement to existing skill
- [ ] Bug fix (typo, broken link, incorrect information)
- [ ] Documentation update (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)
- [ ] CI/Infrastructure

## Checklist

### For New Skills

- [ ] Skill file is in the correct `skills/<category>/` directory
- [ ] File follows the [skill template format](CONTRIBUTING.md#skill-file-template)
- [ ] Minimum 100 lines
- [ ] Contains all required sections:
  - [ ] When to Use
  - [ ] Instructions for AI Assistant
  - [ ] Templates (with working code/commands)
  - [ ] Common Patterns
  - [ ] Pitfalls to Avoid
- [ ] Practical, copy-paste-ready examples included
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or credentials
- [ ] README.md skills table updated

### For Skill Improvements

- [ ] Change is described clearly in the PR description
- [ ] Existing templates and examples still work
- [ ] No breaking changes to the skill's structure
- [ ] New content follows the existing style

### General

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Markdown renders correctly
- [ ] No broken links
- [ ] File encoding is UTF-8
